ideas.pitch: An AI-powered 3D digital twin platform for real-time campus energy anomaly detection and visualization.
ideas.problem_statement: AI, Data Science & Digital Innovation / Smart Infrastructure & Environmental Sustainability
ideas.title: Campus3D Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the architecture of CampusPulse, leveraging an isolation forest model combined with 3D visualization to secure high marks from technical judges valuing hard engineering.

ideas.pitch: A logistics emissions monitoring and route optimization dashboard powered by Power BI and Python telemetry.
ideas.title: LogiCarbon BI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the exact winning pattern of the IBM carbon footprint project, prioritizing an interactive live-working analytics dashboard that gives corporate judges clear, measurable environmental metrics.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computed smart garbage classification system combining computer vision with an Arduino-based sorting mechanism.
ideas.title: EcoSort AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the blueprint of the TechnoMorph runner-up by delivering a tangible hardware-software integrated demo that works live during judging.

ideas.pitch: A mobile-friendly asset management and consumable tracking application tailored for rural water sustainability schemes.
ideas.title: JalAsset Panchayat
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the Smart India Hackathon runner-up JalSetu strategy, offering immediate civic-tech utility that appeals heavily to academic and civil engineering organizers.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning pipeline predicting renewable energy grid fluctuations using localized weather and load datasets.
ideas.title: GridPredict ML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the proven pipeline approach of the UT Austin Energy AI Hackathon winner, demonstrating robust predictive capability directly targeted at sustainability tracks.
